text: Out of scope: electrical protection and switchgear control (ALP-EPC-00000-EL-DBR-0001), process design criteria and instrument data sheets; detail design of loops is in the DCS functional design specification (ALP-EPC-00000-IC-SPC-0005), the alarm management philosophy (ALP-EPC-00000-IC-RPT-0001), the OT cybersecurity concept (ALP-EPC-00000-IC-RPT-0002) and the BOP SIS safety requirements specification (ALP-EPC-00000-IC-SPC-0006).
